title: The passive with se: what the new states created

sections.content: You know the *se* passive from B1 Unit 6 (*se publican las leyes*): *se* + a verb in the third person, with no agent, and the verb agrees with the noun that follows. It is the natural way to say what was created, built or introduced when you do not need to say who did it. Use it for the new ministries, banks and taxes of the early twentieth century.

items.spanish: Se crearon ministerios y bancos centrales.
items.english: Ministries and central banks were created.

items.spanish: Se creó un ministerio de salud.
items.english: A ministry of health was created.

items.spanish: Se introdujo un impuesto sobre los ingresos.
items.english: A tax on income was introduced.

items.spanish: Se fundaron academias para los oficiales.

sections.content: Singular noun, singular verb (*se creó un banco*); plural noun, plural verb (*se crearon bancos*). Do not add *por* + a person to a *se* sentence: if you want to name who acted, use the *ser* passive or an active verb.
